SELECT m.minihome_id AS minihomeId, m.title AS title, m.background_color_id AS backgroundColor, m.theme_theme_id AS appliedThemeId, m.created_at AS createdAt, m.updated_at AS updatedAt,
u.user_id AS userId, u.nickname AS nickname, u.profile_photo_path AS profileImage, u.status_message AS statusMessage, u.birth_date AS birthDate, u.gender AS gender, u.region AS region, u.hobby AS hobby,
-- todayMood와 youtubeVideoId는 DB에 없으므로 NULL로 설정 NULL AS todayMood, NULL AS youtubeVideoId,
-- 방문자 수 (임시로 고정값, 나중에 visit_stats 테이블 연결) 13 AS todayCount, 1337 AS totalCount
FROM minihome m JOIN user u ON m.minihome_owner_id = u.user_id WHERE m.minihome_owner_id = #{minihomeOwnerId}
